title: Allow for This Session — the two-step choice

steps.headline: The broad choice now reads Allow for This Session.
steps.changed: The blue button's shorter label leaves the one-time Approve and Deny controls unchanged.
steps.notice: Choosing it never starts the edit immediately; a second confirmation follows.

steps.headline: A second step explains exactly what is being allowed.
steps.changed: It names this edit and all outside folders, says specialists remain in their work directories, and states that the allowance resets on close or resume.
steps.notice: Back grants nothing. Confirm and edit approves this edit and later outside edits for this session; secret-file blocks stay in place.
